html:
Explore the heart of Saigon with Vietlook Travel and immerse yourself in the city’s rich history, culture, and local lifestyle. This tour combines architecture, iconic landmarks, and authentic experiences that give you a real sense of Saigonese life. Perfect for first-time visitors or anyone wanting to understand the city beyond the usual sights.

PARTNER PRICE: 35 USD / person

Duration: Half-day / 4 hours | Schedule: Morning 08:00 – 12:00 | Afternoon 13:00 – 17:00

Transportation: Walking and Vehicle

Highlights / Itinerary

Jade Emperor Pagoda – “Chua Ngoc Hoang”

Step into one of Saigon’s most vibrant and spiritually significant temples. Built in 1909 and dedicated to the King of Heaven, the pagoda impresses visitors with intricate statues, detailed carvings, and a mystical atmosphere reflecting Vietnamese religious culture.

Pink Church – “Nha Tho Tan Dinh”

Marvel at the stunning Romanian-style architecture and the unique pink exterior of this iconic Catholic church. It’s a favorite photo spot and a symbol of the city’s diverse cultural influences.

Thich Quang Duc Monument

Learn the poignant story of the monk who self-immolated in 1963 to defend Buddhism, an event that shaped modern Vietnamese history. Our guide will explain the significance of this act and its impact on Saigonese society.

Vietnamese Coffee – One of the Oldest Coffee Shops in Saigon

Enjoy a cup of authentic Vietnamese coffee in a historic coffee shop, where you can experience the original taste and learn about the local coffee culture that has been part of Saigon life for decades.

Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment – Oldest Apartment in Saigon

Step inside one of the oldest residential buildings in the city, built in 1968. Here you can see traditional living spaces, meet local residents, and feel the authentic atmosphere of Saigonese daily life.

Nguyen Hue Walking Street

Take a leisurely walk along this iconic pedestrian street, the heart of modern Saigon. From its transformation over 150 years from a canal to a bustling boulevard you’ll gain insight into how the city has evolved while enjoying the lively street ambiance.

This tour is perfect for travelers who want to combine sightseeing, culture, and local experiences in just a few hours. With Vietlook Travel, you’ll discover Saigon’s hidden gems, take stunning photos, and enjoy authentic moments that go beyond a typical city tour.
